description: Thunukkai Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Road details for Thunukkai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of road names and details belonging to Thunukkai Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes a comprehensive inventory of roads with their specifications and provides notice procedures for land ownership claims related to these roads, which falls under land registrations and property matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
